purpose: Screen a new supervision target for the existing dynamic controller: within-question progress toward completion, instead of lexical/confidence reflection classes.

basis.inference: A within-trajectory temporal contrast controls question content across its two sides. A late direction may act on completion behavior even when it is not a correctness readout. This is a separately named adaptation, not a reproduction of the paper's gold lock-on vector or trained self-halt.

construction.eligibility: Original saved calibration answer must finish with stop and contain </think>. Require at least two stored complete steps in each temporal quarter. Do not select by answer correctness. Report excluded counts and reasons.
construction.temporal_contrast: For each eligible question, use existing selected-layer first-content states whose original generated start positions lie in (0,0.25*thinking_length) versus [0.75*thinking_length,thinking_length). Remove the prompt-first state. Average states within each side, then average late-minus-early differences equally across questions.
construction.cpu_split: Reuse the original400/100 question groups, already used for layer selection. Fit the direction on eligible training questions only for CPU readout checks; no layer, window or threshold sweep. This is development evidence.
construction.proposed_asset: If CPU checks pass, refit the same formula on all eligible original calibration questions. Negate the late-minus-early direction and scale it to the original vector's Euclidean norm, so unchanged negative dynamic coefficients push toward late states. Only the vector changes in any subsequent generation comparison.
construction.unchanged: Model1.5B, HF hidden21/decoder output20, first-content extraction, runtime delimiter placement, all original dynamic parameters, arithmetic confidence and both coefficient signs. No extra forward, runtime classifier, forced stop or weight training.

decision: Any failed CPU criterion stops this candidate without changing temporal windows or using GPU. A pass permits preparing a new100-question paired screen with5percent thinking AND total reduction, no fewer correct answers and no more caps; only a passing screen may use independently reserved200 questions.
cost: Local memmapped selected states and saved token IDs. No model load, new answer generation or hidden replay.
limitations: Temporal labels are constructed with the completed calibration trace. They are training supervision, never an inference-time signal or a correctness guarantee.
The original first-content versus runtime-delimiter mismatch is retained to isolate the vector replacement; this candidate does not fix that mismatch.
The pool excludes incomplete calibration traces for defining the terminal quarter, but all errors and capped outputs must remain in any generation evaluation.
A direction can separate stages while being a bad causal intervention. CPU success establishes only the intended progression signal and its stability.
